The commercial requirement

Vehicle care built around the work.

Retail stock has to look convincing in online photographs and during an in-person viewing. Dust, interior marks, bonded contamination and paint swirls can all reduce the perceived quality of an otherwise strong vehicle.

Our Norwich team can match the level of preparation to the individual car: safe washing for fresh stock, complete valeting for a customer handover, or machine polishing where the paint needs greater clarity. In-house preparation teams can also hire the professional indoor bay when additional space or equipment is required.

  • Retail-ready interior and exterior valeting
  • Safe washing before photography
  • Targeted paint enhancement
  • Flexible bay hire for in-house preparation teams
01

Photography-ready stock

Clean glass, wheels, paint and interiors support sharper listing photographs and a more consistent online presentation.

02

Used-car variation

One car may only need careful washing while another needs extraction cleaning, decontamination or paint correction before retail display.

03

Handover standards

Sold vehicles and demonstrators can be prepared around the agreed presentation standard and available handover window.

A clear working process

From requirement to handover.

Every enquiry starts with the vehicles, the operating requirement and the result your business needs.

  1. 01

    Identify the objective

    Confirm whether the vehicle is being photographed, placed on display, used as a demonstrator or prepared for handover.

  2. 02

    Inspect the vehicle

    Interior condition, exterior contamination and paint defects are checked so avoidable work is not added to the preparation.

  3. 03

    Select the route

    Choose from published washing, valeting, polishing or bay-hire options with costs linked to the vehicle and required result.

  4. 04

    Complete the final check

    The finished vehicle is reviewed for consistent presentation before collection or its next dealership task.

The Merl Grey pearl paint was thoroughly decontaminated and prepared before Gyeon Evo ceramic protection was applied, creating a deep, lustrous glimmer while making future maintenance easier.

This genuine Auto Opulence project demonstrates vehicle-care processes that can also be relevant when planning work for car dealerships. It is not presented as a claim that the customer belonged to this business sector.

Car Dealerships FAQs

Planning the work.

Can you prepare used dealership stock for photography?

Yes. We can recommend washing, interior and exterior valeting, decontamination or polishing according to the condition of the vehicle and the standard required for photography.

Do all dealership vehicles need machine polishing?

No. Polishing should be selected from paint condition and the intended result. Well-presented stock may only need a safe wash or valet, while visibly swirled paint may benefit from Stage 1 or multi-stage correction.

Can dealership preparation teams hire the bay?

Yes. Trade users can book three-hour, full-day or day-and-overnight sessions, subject to availability and the relevant hire terms.

Can you clean vehicle interiors before customer handover?

Yes. Interior services range from routine vacuuming and surface care to deep cleaning for more heavily marked upholstery, carpets and load areas.

How do we request preparation for several vehicles?

Send the number, type and condition of the vehicles, the required standard and preferred completion dates. We will confirm the most suitable services and available capacity.
